entryStyleRules: .omnimux-poster-action-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0px; border: 0px; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; filter: drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45) 0px 0px 1px); cursor: pointer; box-sizing: border-box; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; color: var(--omnimux-poster-brand, currentColor) !important; }
.omnimux-poster-action-button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--omnimux-poster-brand, currentColor) 16%,transparent); color: var(--omnimux-poster-brand, currentColor) !important; }
